AUTHOR-CONFIRMED, replacing the generated draft. The impact set is empty and that is the correct prediction, for a reason the graph cannot see.

All three files are new and unreferenced BY DESIGN, not incidentally. deploy/scrutator-deploy-broker is not called from this repository at all: it is installed to /usr/local/sbin on arcana-prd by an operator, and invoked there through the sudoers rule shipped beside it. That is the point of the gh-triage precedent it follows — a deploy script taken from the checkout would let any change to it take effect with the same push, so the copy here is the source of truth for review and reinstallation, never the artefact that runs.

Consequently no edge from this change can reach running code until a human installs it, and a graph edge to it would be the defect rather than the evidence: if any workflow in this repository referenced deploy/scrutator-deploy-broker, the boundary would already be broken.

What the change does NOT touch, checked rather than assumed: deploy/scrutator-deploy-transaction.sh is unmodified, so the deploy's behaviour — surface-SHA verification, image build, health gate, rollback of source/image/env/timer state — is byte-identical to what is already reviewed and already running. The broker only supplies the authority to invoke it.
